sources.title: UkisAI / Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-27B
sources.snippet: The results below compare Qwen3.8-27B, the foundation base model, Swift 1.0, the first UkisAI adaptation, and Swift 1.5. All three use the same saved evaluation protocols, and every score is a final five-repeat aggregate.

sources.title: Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-OrcaRouter-DFlash2-NVFP4-NInfer
sources.snippet: This is an NInfer v3 conversion of ajgazin's Swift 1.5 NVFP4 checkpoint. It includes text, vision, the built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) head, a separate DFlash2 draft model, and an indexed proposal head.
